lec02em-scene-u05.name: 概似不降不等於全域最佳

lec02em-scene-u06.name: 百點迭代逐漸分開兩群

lec02em-frame-u01.name: lec02em-frame-u01
lec02em-frame-u01.text: 混合密度疊加多個元件

lec02em-u01-1-body.name: lec02em-u01-1-body
lec02em-u01-1-body.text: 一個高斯是一座山；混合模型把多座山疊起來。橘：元件1；藍：元件2。

lec02em-u01-1-english.name: lec02em-u01-1-english
lec02em-u01-1-english.text: A mixture adds component densities; J is the component count, x the observed feature vector.

lec02em-u01-2-title.name: lec02em-u01-2-title
lec02em-u01-2-title.text: 兩座峰不能硬塞成一座

lec02em-u01-2-english.name: lec02em-u01-2-english
lec02em-u01-2-english.text: Lecture single-Gaussian ML fit: 600 samples, seed 7; peak 0.231 near the saddle. Weighted components are dashed.

lec02em-u01-3-body.name: lec02em-u01-3-body
lec02em-u01-3-body.text:
✗ 參數多就一定比較好。
✓ 更靈活也更易過擬合；用模型選擇或領域知識決定元件數。

lec02em-u01-3-english.name: lec02em-u01-3-english
lec02em-u01-3-english.text: P_j is both a sampling probability and a curve weight. More components are not automatically better.

lec02em-u02-1-body.name: lec02em-u02-1-body
lec02em-u02-1-body.text: 知道標籤，容易估參數；知道參數，容易猜標籤。先粗猜，再輪流更新。

lec02em-u02-1-english.name: lec02em-u02-1-english
lec02em-u02-1-english.text: Missing labels are hidden variables j_k: the incomplete-data problem.

lec02em-u02-2-body.name: lec02em-u02-2-body
lec02em-u02-2-body.text: 完整資料可分群估計；觀測資料的對數包住加總，微分後無法各自一步解。

lec02em-u02-2-english.name: lec02em-u02-2-english
lec02em-u02-2-english.text: Complete-data likelihood uses known j_k; observed likelihood sums over every possible component.

lec02em-u02-3-title.name: lec02em-u02-3-title
lec02em-u02-3-title.text: 肉眼分群不等於知道標籤

lec02em-u02-3-english.name: lec02em-u02-3-english
lec02em-u02-3-english.text: Single fit: centre (1.19,1.19), 2-sigma semi-axes 1.20/0.56, angle 49.8°. Mixture circles: radii 0.63/0.65. High dimensions or overlap defeat visual labels.

lec02em-u03-1-body.name: lec02em-u03-1-body
lec02em-u03-1-body.text: 用目前參數比較加權密度，再除以所有元件的加權密度總和。

lec02em-u03-1-english.name: lec02em-u03-1-english
lec02em-u03-1-english.text: gamma_kj is responsibility; Theta(t) contains means, variances and mixing coefficients.

lec02em-u03-2-title.name: lec02em-u03-2-title
lec02em-u03-2-title.text: 一半一半是誠實的答案

lec02em-u03-2-english.name: lec02em-u03-2-english
lec02em-u03-2-english.text: Densities cross at x=0.5. Responsibilities are smooth probabilities in [0,1], summing to one for each sample.

lec02em-u03-3-body.name: lec02em-u03-3-body
lec02em-u03-3-body.text:
✗ 責任度就是分群標籤。
✓ 責任度是連續機率；取最大才變成硬分群。

lec02em-u03-3-english.name: lec02em-u03-3-english
lec02em-u03-3-english.text: When unsure, say so; 0.5 is an honest answer. EM retains the uncertainty that a hard assignment discards.

lec02em-u04-1-body.name: lec02em-u04-1-body
lec02em-u04-1-body.text: 每個點有一部分屬於每群；均值、變異數、混合係數都用責任度加權。

lec02em-u04-1-english.name: lec02em-u04-1-english
lec02em-u04-1-english.text: Each update is a weighted average; hard integer labels become probability weights.

lec02em-u04-2-title.name: lec02em-u04-2-title
lec02em-u04-2-title.text: 均值與係數有解析更新

lec02em-u04-2-body.name: lec02em-u04-2-body
lec02em-u04-2-body.text: N是樣本總數；責任度總和是有效群大小，不必梯度法調混合係數。

lec02em-u04-2-english.name: lec02em-u04-2-english
lec02em-u04-2-english.text: The new mean is a responsibility-weighted average. The mixing coefficient is the average responsibility.

lec02em-u04-3-title.name: lec02em-u04-3-title
lec02em-u04-3-title.text: 球形變異數要除以維度

lec02em-u04-3-body.name: lec02em-u04-3-body
lec02em-u04-3-body.text: l是特徵維度；平方距離加總l個座標。責任度總和趨近0，分母會出問題。

lec02em-u04-3-english.name: lec02em-u04-3-english
lec02em-u04-3-english.text: For Sigma_j = sigma_j^2 I, divide by l for per-coordinate variance. Lecture warning: do not confuse the covariance with sigma_j^2.

lec02em-u04-4-title.name: lec02em-u04-4-title
lec02em-u04-4-title.text: 三點軟分配仍各分一點五

lec02em-u04-5-english.name: lec02em-u04-5-english
lec02em-u04-5-english.text: Component 2: (0.269×0.5+0.5×1.0+0.731×1.5)/1.5=1.154. Initial means 0 and 2 move together.

lec02em-frame-u05.name: lec02em-frame-u05
lec02em-frame-u05.text: 概似不降不等於全域最佳

lec02em-u05-1-body.name: lec02em-u05-1-body
lec02em-u05-1-body.text: E步建替代尺，M步找替代尺最高點；再更新參數，重複。

lec02em-u05-1-english.name: lec02em-u05-1-english
lec02em-u05-1-english.text: The stand-in ruler touches the likelihood at the current parameters and stays below it.

lec02em-u05-2-body.name: lec02em-u05-2-body
lec02em-u05-2-body.text: E步計算完整資料對數概似的期望；M步最大化Q。

lec02em-u05-2-english.name: lec02em-u05-2-english
lec02em-u05-2-english.text: E: expectation of complete-data log-likelihood. M: Theta(t+1)=argmax_Theta Q(Theta;Theta(t)).

lec02em-u05-3-english.name: lec02em-u05-3-english
lec02em-u05-3-english.text: 100 points, seed 3261. Likelihood is monotone: L(Theta(t+1)) ≥ L(Theta(t)).

lec02em-u05-4-english.name: lec02em-u05-4-english
lec02em-u05-4-english.text: The gain shrinks: cheap steps may require many iterations; no Hessian is needed, but convergence is usually slower than Newton.

lec02em-u05-5-body.name: lec02em-u05-5-body
lec02em-u05-5-body.text:
✓ 概似不減，收斂到駐點。
✗ 不保證全域最大；不同初始值可能停在不同高度。

lec02em-u05-5-english.name: lec02em-u05-5-english
lec02em-u05-5-english.text: Never getting worse is a guarantee; ending at the best is not. No Hessian is required.

lec02em-frame-u06.name: lec02em-frame-u06
lec02em-frame-u06.text: 百點迭代逐漸分開兩群

lec02em-u06-1-title.name: lec02em-u06-1-title
lec02em-u06-1-title.text: 初始中心刻意幾乎重疊

lec02em-u06-1-english.name: lec02em-u06-1-english
lec02em-u06-1-english.text: Initial means (1.37,1.20)/(1.81,1.62), variances 0.1000/0.1000, P1=0.5000; L=-184.8514. Initial centre distance 0.61. Analytic responsibility field and 2-sigma contours.

lec02em-u06-2-body.name: lec02em-u06-2-body
lec02em-u06-2-body.text: 第1次大幅改善；第2次中心分開，模糊點只剩10個。

lec02em-u06-3-body.name: lec02em-u06-3-body
lec02em-u06-3-body.text: 第3到5次仍上升；中心繼續向兩團貼近。

lec02em-u06-4-body.name: lec02em-u06-4-body
lec02em-u06-4-body.text: 第10次模糊點降到8個；第一元件2標準差半徑穩定約0.63。

lec02em-u06-4-english.name: lec02em-u06-4-english
lec02em-u06-4-english.text: t=10: mu1=(1.054,1.023), mu2=(1.901,2.066), v1=.0981, v2=.1072, P1=.8414, L=-92.3147. Analytic responsibility field, no sample labels required.

lec02em-u06-5-title.name: lec02em-u06-5-title
lec02em-u06-5-title.text: 樣本比例不必等於生成比例

lec02em-u06-5-body.name: lec02em-u06-5-body
lec02em-u06-5-body.text: 第20次接近收斂；83點與17點的組成，使0.843比0.8更貼近這批資料。

lec02em-u06-6-body.name: lec02em-u06-6-body
lec02em-u06-6-body.text: EM收斂到概似駐點，不等於無偏估計；初始值與這批資料都影響結果。

lec02em-u06-6-english.name: lec02em-u06-6-english
lec02em-u06-6-english.text: The starting point decides which mountain you are climbing. This successful run does not prove unbiased recovery of the true parameters.

lec02em-frame-u07.name: lec02em-frame-u07
lec02em-frame-u07.text: 軟分配比硬標籤多留信心

lec02em-u07-1-body.name: lec02em-u07-1-body
lec02em-u07-1-body.text: K-means：0或1，只更新中心。EM：責任度，更新中心、變異數與係數。

lec02em-u07-1-english.name: lec02em-u07-1-english
lec02em-u07-1-english.text: K-means: hard counts, equal size/orientation, within-cluster squared error never increases. EM: total responsibility, component-specific shape, likelihood never falls.

lec02em-u07-2-title.name: lec02em-u07-2-title
lec02em-u07-2-title.text: 中間點需要保留不確定性

lec02em-u07-2-body.name: lec02em-u07-2-body
lec02em-u07-2-body.text: 中間點(1.360,1.804)，責任度0.480；硬分群仍得二選一。

lec02em-u07-2-english.name: lec02em-u07-2-english
lec02em-u07-2-english.text: K-means centres (1.037,1.000)/(1.835,1.990), counts 81/19. EM centres (1.055,1.024)/(1.905,2.069), totals 84.28/15.72. Analytic EM responsibility field.

lec02em-u07-3-body.name: lec02em-u07-3-body
lec02em-u07-3-body.text: 固定等大小球形、相等係數，責任度取最大，就得到硬分配特例。

lec02em-u07-3-english.name: lec02em-u07-3-english
lec02em-u07-3-english.text: K-means is cheaper per cycle and useful for huge or high-dimensional data; it often supplies EM initial centres.

lec02em-frame-u08.name: lec02em-frame-u08
lec02em-frame-u08.text: 概似很大也可能是漏洞

lec02em-u08-1-trap0cn.name: lec02em-u08-1-trap0cn
lec02em-u08-1-trap0cn.text: 局部極值：多起點取最高概似

lec02em-u08-1-trap1cn.name: lec02em-u08-1-trap1cn
lec02em-u08-1-trap1cn.text: 變異數崩塌：設下界或正則化

lec02em-u08-1-trap2cn.name: lec02em-u08-1-trap2cn
lec02em-u08-1-trap2cn.text: 元件數錯：選模或領域知識

lec02em-u08-2-title.name: lec02em-u08-2-title
lec02em-u08-2-title.text: 變異數崩塌不是好答案

lec02em-u08-2-body.name: lec02em-u08-2-body
lec02em-u08-2-body.text: 中心落在一點，變異數趨近0，密度與概似衝向無限大；可設下界10⁻³。

lec02em-u08-2-english.name: lec02em-u08-2-english
lec02em-u08-2-english.text: The model exploits a loophole: arbitrarily large likelihood destroys generalisation. Too many components can become empty; too few merge peaks.

lec02em-u08-3-title.name: lec02em-u08-3-title
lec02em-u08-3-title.text: 穩定責任度要避免下溢

lec02em-u08-3-body.name: lec02em-u08-3-body
lec02em-u08-3-body.text: 密度可能小到變0；取指數前先減最大值。概似大不代表模型好。

lec02em-u08-3-english.name: lec02em-u08-3-english
lec02em-u08-3-english.text: Use the log-sum-exp trick for responsibilities. A large likelihood only says the model explains this particular sample well.

lec02em-u08-3-stable-c2-t.name: lec02em-u08-3-stable-c2-t
lec02em-u08-3-stable-c2-t.text:
指數與正規化
exp, normalize

lec02em-frame-u09.name: lec02em-frame-u09
lec02em-frame-u09.text: 記住軟分配與加權更新

lec02em-u09-1-body.name: lec02em-u09-1-body
lec02em-u09-1-body.text: 混合是加權和；未知標籤讓概似糾纏。E算軟責任度；M做加權更新並除以維度。

lec02em-u09-1-english.name: lec02em-u09-1-english
lec02em-u09-1-english.text: Monotone likelihood is not global optimality. Initial values, variance floor and component count are key choices.

lec02em-u09-2-title.name: lec02em-u09-2-title
lec02em-u09-2-title.text: 再跑一輪只給參數提示

lec02em-u09-2-body.name: lec02em-u09-2-body
lec02em-u09-2-body.text: 練習：三點再跑一輪；互換百點例的初始中心，先預測再實作。

lec02em-u09-2-english.name: lec02em-u09-2-english
lec02em-u09-2-english.text: Hints only, no solutions. Three points: x=.5,1,1.5; new means .846/1.154, variances .143/.143. Swap mu1(0) and mu2(0); which component captures the large cloud?

lec02em-u09-3-title.name: lec02em-u09-3-title
lec02em-u09-3-title.text: 硬分群與比例值得再思考

lec02em-u09-3-body.name: lec02em-u09-3-body
lec02em-u09-3-body.text: 練習：責任度0.480的點硬分哪群？為何係數收斂0.843，不是0.8？

lec02em-u09-3-english.name: lec02em-u09-3-english
lec02em-u09-3-english.text: Hints only: compare squared distances to both centres for point (1.360,1.804). Count how many of the 100 points actually came from component 1.

lec02em-u09-4-title.name: lec02em-u09-4-title
lec02em-u09-4-title.text: 中英術語對照核心概念

lec02em-u09-4-body.name: lec02em-u09-4-body
lec02em-u09-4-body.text: 混合模型／混合係數／元件分布；不完整資料／隱藏變數；責任度／軟性分配。

lec02em-u09-4-english.name: lec02em-u09-4-english
lec02em-u09-4-english.text:
mixture model / mixing coefficient / component density
incomplete data / hidden variable
responsibility / soft assignment
E step (expectation) / M step (maximization)

lec02em-u09-5-title.name: lec02em-u09-5-title
lec02em-u09-5-title.text: 中英術語串起實作警告

lec02em-u09-5-body.name: lec02em-u09-5-body
lec02em-u09-5-body.text: 對數概似／完整資料概似／概似下界；局部極值／變異數崩塌；硬分派／球形共變異數。

lec02em-u09-5-english.name: lec02em-u09-5-english
lec02em-u09-5-english.text:
log-likelihood / complete-data log-likelihood / lower bound
local optimum / variance collapse / total responsibility
K-means clustering / hard assignment / spherical covariance / GMM
Reading: Theodoridis & Koutroumbas, Pattern Recognition, 4th ed., §2.5.5; course §2.5 point 13 (2026-10-09).
